primary_track: Track 02 — The Agent That Can Explain Why
query: Why did Q3 enterprise retention drop across our Computer & Office Equipment accounts, and how do SEC EDGAR revenues compare with our internal support escalation and billing tables?
executive_summary: Investigation for "Why did Q3 enterprise retention drop across our Computer & Office Equipment accounts, and how do SEC EDGAR revenues compare with our interna" (focus: Computer & Office Equipment). Q3 net revenue retention in the focus cohort contracted: 86.99% across 7 accounts (-$2.47M ARR, 310 contract events) vs 101.67% across 3 comparison accounts. (1) Operational driver (correlational): P1 escalations 13->88, p99 latency up to 2,140ms, timeout rate r=0.962 with retention loss, $530K SLA credits. (2) Taxonomic data blindspot: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP (CIK 0000051143) files under summary SIC 3570, which a naive EDGAR x SIC join drops ($62.753B FY2025 revenue); fk_sic_check flagged it and Pass 2 recovered it, reconciled to leaf 3571. (3) Forward risk: Computer & Office Equipment carries $2.08M in Q4 weather SLA penalty exposure, led by IBM $620K in us-east-ny, CSCO $390K in us-east-nc, WDC $280K in us-west-ca. Blocked as untested (no supporting rows in Zetaris): H4 Enterprise Pricing-Tier & Rate-Card Change Impact; H_EXT Competitor Contract Displacement / Bundling.

Across all 10 accounts, timeout rate correlates with retention loss at r=0.962. $530K in SLA credits were issued; cohort NRR 86.99% (-$2.47M ARR).
why_explanation.primary_data_discrepancy_driver: Zetaris DQ rule fk_sic_check shows INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP (CIK 0000051143) files under SEC SIC 3570, which is not a 4-digit leaf in company_dns.sic_codes. A naive inner join silently drops its $62.753B FY2025 revenue and -$730K Q3 ARR movement. Reconciled under Division D (Manufacturing) -> Major Group 35 -> Industry Group 357 -> Leaf 3571 (Electronic Computers). hypotheses.description: Test whether the focus cohort's Q2->Q3 net revenue retention contracted, and by more than the comparison cohort. Focus cohort: Computer & Office Equipment (named_segment).
sql_queries: SELECT industry_segment, COUNT(*) AS accounts_count, SUM(q3_arr_usd) AS q3_arr_total_usd, AVG(q3_net_retention_pct) AS avg_q3_net_retention_pct FROM erp.customer_churn_billing GROUP BY industry_segment
hypotheses.finding_summary: Computer & Office Equipment: 7 accounts averaged 86.99% Q3 net retention (-$2.47M ARR delta, $530K SLA credits) vs 101.67% across 3 comparison accounts.

hypotheses.title: Cross-Source SEC EDGAR vs. US SIC V4 Taxonomic Integrity
hypotheses.description: Verify that every SEC EDGAR self-reported SIC code joins to a 4-digit US SIC V4 leaf, so no filer is silently dropped from cohort reporting.
sql_queries: SELECT e.cik, e.ticker, e.company_name, e.sic_code AS edgar_sic_code, e.industry_group, e.revenue_2024, e.revenue_2025, s.sic_code AS leaf_sic_code, s.description AS leaf_sic_description FROM edgar.company_facts e JOIN company_dns.sic_codes s ON e.sic_code = s.sic_code LIMIT 1000
hypotheses.finding_summary: IBM (CIK 0000051143) reports SEC SIC 3570, a summary header absent from the 4-digit leaf table; reconciled to 3571 (Electronic Computers), restoring $62.753B FY2025 revenue and $4.12M Q3 ARR

result.summary: Investigation for "Why did Q3 enterprise retention drop across our Computer & Office Equipment accounts, and how do SEC EDGAR revenues compare with our interna" (focus: Computer & Office Equipment). Q3 net revenue retention in the focus cohort contracted: 86.99% across 7 accounts (-$2.47M ARR, 310 contract events) vs 101.67% across 3 comparison accounts. (1) Operational driver (correlational): P1 escalations 13->88, p99 latency up to 2,140ms, timeout rate r=0.962 with retention loss, $530K SLA credits. (2) Taxonomic data blindspot: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP (CIK 0000051143) files under summary SIC 3570, which a naive EDGAR x SIC join drops ($62.753B FY2025 revenue); fk_sic_check flagged it and Pass 2 recovered it, reconciled to leaf 3571. (3) Forward risk: Computer & Office Equipment carries $2.08M in Q4 weather SLA penalty exposure, led by IBM $620K in us-east-ny, CSCO $390K in us-east-nc, WDC $280K in us-west-ca. Blocked as untested (no supporting rows in Zetaris): H4 Enterprise Pricing-Tier & Rate-Card Change Impact; H_EXT Competitor Contract Displacement / Bundling.
